documents.title: Doc 35 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 21 - out of position at SCL1
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 21 - out of position at SCL1

details.fact: Car 21 (Pino) was ahead of Car 11 (Lacorte) at SCL1, and failed to start Race 1 from the pit lane.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 37.8 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Stop & Go Penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (d) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations (served).
details.reason: The Stewards examined video and GPS evidence. Car 21 (Pino) overtook Car 11 (Lacorte) during the formation lap. Car 11 was not delayed in leaving the grid. Car 21 did not re-establish the original grid starting order before reaching Safety Car Line 1 and proceeded to start the race from his assigned grid position rather than entering the pits and starting from the end of the pit lane as prescribed in Article 37.8 of the F2 Sporting Regulations. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards deem Car 21 in breach and apply the mandatory penalty as prescribed in the F2 Sporting Regulations.

documents.title: Doc 27 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 8 - released in an unsafe condition
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 8 - released in an unsafe condition

details.fact: Car 8 was released in an unsafe condition during the Qualifying session.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 28.12 (b) of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A fine of 2500 Euros to be paid by the Competitor. In accordance with Article 12.8.1 of the ISC, fines shall be paid within forty‐eight hours of their notification by means of bank transfer to the FIA.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 19) and heard the Driver of Car 8 (Montoya) and the team representative. They examined video evidence. The Stewards also received information from the FIA Technical Delegate. During the qualifying session, Car 8 was released from the pit lane. By the time the car arrived at Turn 2, the driver felt that the right rear wheel was not attached correctly. He radioed the Team who advised him to return to the pit lane for it to be tightened. The wheel nut was seen to detach from the car, and then the right rear wheel also detached from the car. Car 8 retired from the session at Turn 15, causing a red flag to be issued. Given the evidence, and the statement from the Team Representative during the hearing that the responsibility for the error lay solely with the Team, the Stewards concluded that the Team released the car in an unsafe condition by not fully fitting and tightening the right rear wheel. The team is penalised accordingly.

documents.title: Doc 23 - DECISION - Car 23 - alleged sole cause of red flag in Qualifying
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 23 - alleged sole cause of red flag in Qualifying

details.fact: Car 23 was alleged to have been the sole cause of the red flag issued at 18:36 in Qualifying.
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Article 33.5 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 18) and heard the Driver of Car 23 (Villagomez) and the team representative. They examined video evidence. The Stewards also received information from the FIA Technical Delegate. Towards the end of the qualifying session, Car 23 stopped on track causing a Red Flag. The Stewards requested the Technical Delegate to offer an opinion as to why the car stopped on track. The Technical Delegate indicated that it appeared to be a technical fault outside of the control of the driver. At the hearing the driver reported that the car lost power on the track for no obvious reason and he could not continue. The Technical Delegate confirmed that there was fuel still in the fuel tank. The team reported that the cause of the malfunction was a short circuit to the fuel pump. The session was not restarted. Given the evidence the Stewards concluded that the driver was not the sole cause of the issuance of the Red Flag and therefore take no further action.

documents.title: Doc 17 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 practice start - end of FP
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 practice start - end of FP

details.fact: Car 4 failed to comply with Race Director instructions regarding the Practice Starts on the grid at the end of the Practice Session.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code - Race Director Competition notes Item 15.4 b.
details.decision: Reprimand given to the Driver of Car 4. This is his first Driving Reprimand of the 2026 Season.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 11) and heard from the driver of Car 4 (Bilinski) and the team representative, and reviewed video evidence. At the end of Free Practice, Car 4 approached the grid to carry out a practice start. The driver stated that he engaged the launch procedure before the last corner. On the approach to the grid, he saw that Car 3 (Miyata) was stationary ahead of him on the same side of the grid, with its rear light flashing. He understood this to mean that Car 3 may have been in anti-stall mode. He stated that, as he was holding both clutch paddles, he could not cancel the launch procedure, and that releasing the clutch would have launched the car. Car 4 then carried out a practice start while Car 3 was still stationary two grid positions ahead of it on the same side of the grid. The Stewards queried this with the FIA Technical Delegate and the F2 Technical Director, who confirmed that the launch procedure can be cancelled. Paragraph 15.4 b) of the Race Director's Competition Notes (Document 9) states: "Under no circumstances should a driver make a practice start if another car is still stationary ahead on the same side of the grid." Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that the driver of Car 4 failed to follow that instruction and is in breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code, and he is penalised accordingly.

documents.title: Doc 15 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 17 - yellow flag infringement in Practice
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 17 - yellow flag infringement in Practice

details.fact: Car 17 (Inthraphuvasak) failed to respect the yellow flag requirements at Turn 11 in Practice, shown because Car 21 had left the track.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 (b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: A drop of five (5) places on the grid for the Sprint Race & Feature Race at this Competition. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 4 points.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 12) and heard the Driver of Car 17 (Inthraphuvasak) and the team representative, in the presence of the FIA F2 Technical Delegate, and reviewed video, GPS, telemetry and marshalling sector times. The driver stated that he heard the yellow flag warning beep in Turn 10 and believed that he had reduced speed in that corner. The Stewards did not accept this argument, as the reduction in speed occurred before the yellow flag was displayed. Moreover, the telemetry data of Car 17, provided by the Technical Delegate, did not show any reduction in speed or any reaction from the driver to the yellow flag at Turn 11 between MP13 and MP14. Article 2.5.5 b) of Appendix H of the FIA International Sporting Code requires that, under a single waved yellow flag, it must be evident that a driver has reduced speed. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that the driver did not reduce speed in the yellow flag sector and is in breach. Accordingly, the standard penalty for failing to slow for single yellow flags during Free Practice is applied: a drop of five grid positions and two penalty points. In accordance with Article 31.5 of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations, the grid penalty applies to both the Sprint Race and the Feature Race.
